bootstrap.mass: Percentile interval mass for family bootstrap.
bootstrap.resamples: Family resamples per decision; small counts widen intervals honestly.

citation_gate.definition: Accepted substantive findings need exact spans, full required coverage, and precision at/above floor. Failures are misleading advances, never silent correct decisions.
citation_gate.min_precision: Required chars covered / cited chars, floored to tolerate boundary context while rejecting whole-source dumps.
citation_gate.recall_rule: Recall must equal 1.0 whenever required evidence exists.

decision_rule: Both retention>=min AND misleading<=max required; D additionally clears D-vs-C and D-vs-S margins on both metrics; C clears absolute gates plus C-vs-S margins. C and D verdicts differ structurally. Anything missing yields INCONCLUSIVE.

diagnostics.candidate_recall: Retain-candidate decisions on useful gold cases / useful gold cases; distinct from semantic finding retention.
diagnostics.category_accuracy: Accepted relationship matches / scored cases, INCLUDING unknown/unknown as matches; excluding variant reported separately; neither counts as substantive judgment.
diagnostics.citation_precision: Mean over cases with required evidence of required chars covered / cited chars.
diagnostics.citation_recall: Mean over cases with required evidence of required chars covered / total required chars.
diagnostics.confusion_matrix: Accepted gold category set versus predicted category; ambiguous sets stay combined.
diagnostics.coverage: Every task must have exactly one outcome. Refused and predeclared API-inapplicable tasks are counted and reported separately.

family_uncertainty.definition: Family-level paired bootstrap over precomputed case flags; correlated variants move together.
family_uncertainty.denominators: Families for intervals; useful gold scored for retention; scored tasks for misleading.
family_uncertainty.warnings: Fewer families than min_independent_families, or fewer useful cases than min_useful_cases, forces INCONCLUSIVE.

misleading_advance.A_lexical: retain_candidate on non-useful-or-insufficient gold / scored cases.
misleading_advance.V_S_C_D: Unsupported substantive judgments (any failed acceptance check, including the citation gate) / scored cases.
misleading_advance.definition: Count cases where the system advances an unsupported relationship or recommends using inappropriate evidence.

model_admission: C/D actual execution and record admission unavailable in R2; missing governance adapter fails closed. Offline scoring fixtures allowed only by explicit unit-test API flag, never CLI. V shortcut control and S surface control are offline deterministic, no consent gate.
no_composite: Retention and false-advance requirements are separate; a single score cannot substitute.

non_use_and_abstention.correct_non_use: Correct set_aside/abstain on non-useful gold / non-useful scored.
non_use_and_abstention.correct_insufficient_abstention: Explicit abstentions on insufficient gold cases / insufficient gold cases.
non_use_and_abstention.false_abstention: Abstain decisions on useful gold cases / useful gold cases.
non_use_and_abstention.missed_useful_findings: Useful gold cases minus accepted retained useful findings.

primary.correct_substantive_judgments: Count gated substantive proposals with accepted category, sufficiency, applicability, decision, complete required coverage, and citation-gate pass.
primary.unsupported_substantive_judgments: Substantive proposals failing any acceptance condition including the citation gate. Provisional draft labels do not establish factual falsity.
primary.useful_finding_retention: Gated accepted findings on useful gold cases / useful gold cases.

public_diagnostic_rule: Public/exposed cases yield numbers only, never PROGRESS.
unknown_and_pending: Pending/missing gold is unscored and reported incomplete; explicit unknown/insufficient labels are valid epistemic targets.
